contract: Use the published NonlinearTie K=3, p=2, n=1000 DGP and selection policy.
Use known propensities and two-fold cross-fitted LightGBM outcome nuisances with 30-draw randomized tuning and three-fold CV.
Use joint 95% Bonferroni intervals and Euclidean ranking-score error.
Require all four clean-room 95% Monte Carlo intervals to overlap their paper intervals.
Require debiasing to lower error, raise coverage, and produce a coverage interval containing 0.95.
